Luxury Penthouse Campaign

Editorial property imagery designed for qualified luxury buyers.

YOUR CUSTOMIZED PROMPT

Create an architectural campaign image for a [PROPERTY TYPE] in [CITY], aimed at [BUYER PROFILE]. Showcase [KEY FEATURE] using a wide but natural 24mm perspective, blue-hour exterior balance, warm 2700K interior practical lighting, accurate vertical lines and restrained editorial styling. Materials: [MATERIALS]. Preserve the real floor plan and view. No fake landmarks, people, text or exaggerated room dimensions.

How to use it

  1. Replace the variables using the fields above.
  2. Copy the completed prompt into Gemini or a compatible model.
  3. Review at full resolution and adjust one decision at a time.
EDITORIAL GUIDANCE

Getting a result you can use

Treat this template as a controlled creative brief. Preserve critical source details, make one major change at a time and inspect the final result before commercial use.

Common mistakes

Avoid vague quality words, conflicting styles and large generic negative-prompt lists. State the result, protected details and final placement clearly.

Model behavior changes over time. Review identity, anatomy, text, labels, reflections and rights before publishing.
